correctness.rationale: Gaussian projection KKT reduces face index to N_m(S), with H_m(S)=G0+S. At t solving m E(Z-t)_+=t, normal-tail expansion gives t^2~2 log m, lambda=m Phi_bar(t)~t^2 and lambda-2 log m=o(t). Rare-event Lyapunov for X=(N_m(t)-lambda)/t and Y=H_m(t)-t gives covariance [[1,1],[1,2]]; the root perturbation t^2(S-t)=Y-G0+o_P(1) and monotone local-count bound yield (J_m-lambda)/t=>X-Y+G0, variance 2. The checked actual McCoy–Tropp Thms 4.5 and 4.8 supply Var<=2delta and scaled exponential moments; they upgrade mean/variance convergence by uniform integrability. Independent 120 Gaussian KKT/sorted face-count checks pass but do not prove asymptotics. This claim correctly concerns conic rather than Euclidean simplex intrinsic volumes.
